svg.title: Camera animation clips
svg.desc: Pitch, yaw and roll curves of the CrouchWalk, Idle, Walk and Run camera clips that the Animator blends by moveState.
svg.text: The Euler curves stored in Animations/CameraAnimations, blended by CameraAnimationModule through moveState
Curves are evaluated from the clip keyframes (Hermite tangents); dots mark keys. Playheads run in real time.
